en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4304 - It is narrated from Sa'd ibn al-Hasan, from Abu Abdillah (as), that

Imam (as) was asked about a man who swears that he will not sell his merchandise for a certain price, but then later changes his mind.
Imam (as) said: "He may sell it, and no expiation is required."
